description: PAID $0.005 USDC. go / caution / avoid verdict, 0-100 risk score and the facts behind it (liquidity, holders, top-10 concentration, LP locked, taxes, honeypot, mint/proxy/owner flags) for a token on base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche or solana. No charge if the scan fails. Returns JSON verdict go, caution, or avoid, a 0-100 risk score, and the liquidity, holder, tax, and contract facts behind it.

address.description: Token contract or Solana mint. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a Solana mint. Example: 0x4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the token. Format: a lowercase slug. The tool text names base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, and solana. Example: base. Omit only if the server can infer the chain.
